result.instructions: Tools for bunny.net, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes bunny.net data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run bunny_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bunny_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bunny_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. bunny_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bunny_list_pull_zones
tools.title: List pull zones
tools.description: List the CDN pull zones on the account. By default returns a compact view per zone (id, name, origin URL, enabled/suspended, hostnames, linked storage zone, bandwidth and charges this month); set full=true for every setting. bunny.net: GET /pullzone.

search.description: Filter results by this search term.

full.description: Return every pull zone setting instead of the compact view.

tools.name: bunny_get_pull_zone
tools.title: Get a pull zone
tools.description: Fetch one pull zone with all its settings: origin, hostnames, caching, security, edge rules (with their GUIDs, needed by bunny_set_edge_rule_enabled), blocked IPs, limits and usage. Secrets (token-auth key, AWS signing secret, certificate private keys) are redacted. bunny.net: GET /pullzone/{id}.

include_certificate.description: Include each hostname's public SSL certificate (private keys are always redacted).

tools.name: bunny_list_storage_zones
tools.title: List storage zones
tools.description: List the edge storage zones on the account: region, replication regions, storage used, file count, tier and connected pull zones. Storage passwords are redacted. bunny.net: GET /storagezone.

search.description: Filter results by this search term.

tools.name: bunny_get_storage_zone
tools.title: Get a storage zone
tools.description: Fetch one edge storage zone: hostname, region, replication, storage used, files stored, 404 handling and connected pull zones. Storage passwords are redacted. bunny.net: GET /storagezone/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_get_storage_zone_statistics
tools.title: Get storage zone statistics
tools.description: Daily charts of storage used and file count for one storage zone. bunny.net: GET /storagezone/{id}/statistics.

date_from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

date_to.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

tools.name: bunny_list_dns_zones
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones hosted on bunny.net, with nameserver detection, DNSSEC and logging status. bunny.net: GET /dnszone.

search.description: Filter results by this search term.

tools.name: bunny_get_dns_zone
tools.title: Get a DNS zone
tools.description: Fetch one DNS zone with its settings and records. bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records in one DNS zone, optionally filtered by type or search term. Record Type comes back as bunny.net's integer code (0=A, 1=AAAA, 2=CNAME, 3=TXT, 4=MX, 5=Redirect, 6=Flatten, 7=PullZone, 8=SRV, 9=CAA, 10=PTR, 11=Script, 12=NS, 13=SVCB, 14=HTTPS, 15=TLSA). bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{zoneId}/records.

search.description: Filter results by this search term.

tools.name: bunny_export_dns_zone
tools.title: Export a DNS zone
tools.description: Export one DNS zone as a BIND zone file (plain text) — handy for review, diffing or backup before a change. bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{id}/export.

tools.name: bunny_list_video_libraries
tools.title: List video libraries
tools.description: List the Stream video libraries: video count, storage and traffic usage, linked pull/storage zones and player/encoding settings. Library API keys are redacted. bunny.net: GET /videolibrary.

search.description: Filter results by this search term.

tools.name: bunny_get_video_library
tools.title: Get a video library
tools.description: Fetch one Stream video library with its full configuration (resolutions, DRM, referrer rules, transcribing, watermark). Library API keys are redacted. bunny.net: GET /videolibrary/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_get_statistics
tools.title: Get CDN statistics
tools.description: CDN traffic statistics for the account or one pull zone: total bandwidth, origin traffic, requests served, cache hit rate and average origin response time, plus optional charts (bandwidth, requests, origin traffic, response times, 3xx/4xx/5xx errors, geographic distribution). bunny.net: GET /statistics.

date_from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

date_to.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Omit both dates for the last 30 days.

pull_zone_id.description: Only this pull zone. Omit for the whole account.

load_origin_response_times.description: Include the origin response time chart.

tools.name: bunny_list_regions
tools.title: List edge regions
tools.description: List bunny.net's edge regions with their IDs, codes, location and per-GB traffic price. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. bunny.net: GET /region.

tools.name: bunny_get_billing
tools.title: Get billing details
tools.description: The account balance, this month's charges broken down by product (traffic per continent, storage, DNS, Stream, scripting, Shield, ...) and recent billing records. Payment-method tokens are redacted. bunny.net: GET /billing.

tools.name: bunny_get_audit_log
tools.title: Get the audit log
tools.description: Who changed what on one day: the account audit log (timestamp, product, resource, action, actor and a diff). Paginate with continuation_token. bunny.net: GET /user/audit/{date}.

tools.name: bunny_purge_pull_zone_cache
tools.title: Purge a pull zone's cache
tools.description: WRITE. Purge the cached content of one pull zone — everything, or only files carrying a cache tag. Nothing is lost (the CDN refetches from the origin) but the origin takes the refill load. bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/purgeCache.

cache_tag.description: Only purge files with this cache tag.

tools.name: bunny_purge_url
tools.title: Purge a URL from cache
tools.description: WRITE. Purge one URL from the CDN cache. A URL ending in '/' purges everything under it unless exact_path is true; a '*' wildcard is also accepted. The CDN refetches from the origin. bunny.net: POST /purge.

url.description: The CDN URL to purge, e.g. https://myzone.b-cdn.net/css/site.css.

async.description: Return immediately instead of waiting for the purge to finish.

exact_path.description: For a URL ending in '/', purge only that exact path.

tools.name: bunny_add_dns_record
tools.title: Add a DNS record
tools.description: WRITE. Add a record to a DNS zone. Takes effect on live DNS. bunny.net: PUT /dnszone/{zoneId}/records.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone; empty string for the apex, e.g. 'www'.

value.description: Record value, e.g. an IP for A, a hostname for CNAME, text for TXT.

pull_zone_id.description: Pull Zone ID, for type PullZone.

accelerated.description: Route the record through the CDN (CDN acceleration).

disabled.description: Keep the record but stop serving it.

tools.name: bunny_update_dns_record
tools.title: Update a DNS record
tools.description: WRITE. Update an existing DNS record. Takes effect on live DNS. Read the record first with bunny_list_dns_records and pass its type, name and value along with any other fields you want to keep or change. bunny.net: POST /dnszone/{zoneId}/records/{id}.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone; empty string for the apex, e.g. 'www'.

value.description: Record value, e.g. an IP for A, a hostname for CNAME, text for TXT.

pull_zone_id.description: Pull Zone ID, for type PullZone.

accelerated.description: Route the record through the CDN (CDN acceleration).

disabled.description: Keep the record but stop serving it.

tools.name: bunny_set_edge_rule_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable an edge rule
tools.description: WRITE. Turn one edge rule on a pull zone on or off (reversible — the rule is kept). Get the rule's GUID from bunny_get_pull_zone (EdgeRules[].Guid). bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{pullZoneId}/edgerules/{edgeRuleId}/setEdgeRuleEnabled.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable.

annotations.title: Enable or disable an edge rule

tools.name: bunny_add_blocked_ip
tools.title: Block an IP on a pull zone
tools.description: WRITE. Block an IP address from a pull zone (undo with bunny_remove_blocked_ip). bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/addBlockedIp.

annotations.title: Block an IP on a pull zone

tools.name: bunny_remove_blocked_ip
tools.title: Unblock an IP on a pull zone
tools.description: WRITE. Remove an IP address from a pull zone's block list. bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/removeBlockedIp.

annotations.title: Unblock an IP on a pull zone
